{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|The key to colonization is self-sufficiency.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Colonists-EotECR.png|thumb|right|200px|A Human and Bothan colonist]]
A '''colonist''' was an individual who migrated to a [[Planet/Legends|world]] and exercised power over a part of it as part of a group in an attempt to foster long-term settlement and development for themselves. Colonists had various motivations: some sought better life opportunities, while others set up colonies to hide from religious or [[Politics/Legends|political]] persecution, such as by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], or criminal organizations.<ref name="EotE CR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
